name: modspire
description: Local-first Minecraft Java modpack planner for Windows. Search Modrinth, organize packs, inspect crash logs. AI optional. Try the interactive demo.

paragraphs: 🌌 Your Minecraft Java modpack studio Search Modrinth, build a shortlist, and inspect your Minecraft Java pack. Local-first. AI optional.

Project limits: Modspire helps organize packs and review metadata. It does not download every mod, install a Minecraft loader, or prove that a pack starts in a game world. See the community test disclaimer.
features: 🗂️ Keep multiple pack projects with separate Minecraft versions, loaders, selections, and chat histories.
💬 Describe the experience you want and review AI-assisted Modrinth suggestions before changing your pack.
🔍 Search Modrinth directly without an AI account; filter by topic, version, loader, category, environment, and popularity.
🧩 Add candidates or a pack foundation in batches, inspect dependencies, and review compatibility notes.
📦 Import a Modrinth share code, public pack link, or .mrpack into an editable project, then export your selection.

whatItDoes.text: 🌌 Your Minecraft Java modpack studio Search Modrinth, build a shortlist, and inspect your Minecraft Java pack. Local-first. AI optional.

requirements.text: Catalog search needs no AI account.
CurseForge search requires the user's own approved API key; without one, search falls back to Modrinth.
The bundled Sign in with ChatGPT DevKit has a separate noncommercial licence at vendor/siwc-local/DEVKIT-LICENSE.
